data.name: Dharmander
data.long_meaning: Dharmander is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'dharma' and 'andar'. Dharma means righteousness, morality, and law, while andar means within. Thus, Dharmander signifies one who embodies righteousness and virtues from within.
